name: stamp-card
title: Stamp card
description: A digital loyalty stamp card: a grid of stamps with the filled ones drawn, the reward on the last one, and a Redeem button once the card is full.
docs: total is how many stamps the card has and filled how many are given; they sit in a grid (ten make two rows of five) of circles, the filled ones in the foreground with a check, the empty ones dashed and counting up, and the last one is the reward, drawn with a gift. The card reads as one sentence ('Cappuccino card, 6 of 10 stamps, 4 to go') and the grid is hidden from assistive technology. When filled goes up, each new stamp plays a short press (skipped under reduced motion) and the new count is announced politely. A full card changes its badge to 'Reward ready' and, with onRedeem, shows a Redeem button named with the reward; onRedeem may return a promise and the button shows a spinner until it settles. Without it a full card only says that the reward is unlocked. lastStampedAt is written as a short date in locale and timeZone. label is the heading, headingLevel sets its level, and labels carries every word.
